==Usage==
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Round16
<!-- Date-Place/Team 1/Score 1/Team 2/Score 2 -->
<!-- round of 16  -->
|||||
|||||
|||||
|||||
|||||
|||||
|||||
|||||
<!-- quarter finals  -->
|||||
|||||
|||||
|||||
<!-- semi finals -->
|||||
|||||
<!-- final -->
|||||
<!-- consol=name -->
|||||
}}
</syntaxhighlight>

Use the parameters listed below to customise the template. For example, putting <code>|3rdplace=no|color=yes}}</code> in the last line will remove the 3rd place match place-holder and color the Champion and Runner-up place-holders. The following parameter values are acceptable:

{| class="wikitable"
!Parameter value
!Description
|-
|''RD1=name''||Renames Round of 16 to ''name''.
|-
|''RD2=name''||Renames Quarter-finals to ''name''.
|-
|''RD3=name''||Renames Semi-finals to ''name''.
|-
|''RD4=name''||Renames Final to ''name''.
|-
|''Consol=name''||Renames Third place to ''name''.
|-
|''3rdplace=no''||Remove 3rd place match place-holder.
|-
|''color=yes''||Add color for Gold, Silver & Bronze position.
|-
|''widescore=yes''||Widens score box (for penalty scores etc.).
|-
|''template=yes''||If used in a template (adds V.T.E. link)
|-
|''name=PAGENAME''||Required if used as a template
|}
